verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no dedicated bulk-operation endpoint or bulk UI action. Bulk work is only implied: the docs suggest using the per-candidate create endpoint to migrate a whole spreadsheet of candidates, collection endpoints return lists of jobs and candidates, and the MCP server offers programmatic access an agent could loop over. Multi-board job posting is a single-item fan-out, not a bulk operation across many items. Missing for 10: native batch/bulk API endpoints, bulk actions on many candidates (move stage, reject, email, tag), MCP bulk tools, documented limits or behaviour for batch jobs, and independent corroboration.
